originalTitle: ‘It’s huge’: Nike deal breaks new ground in WSL for London City Lionesses
summary: The Women’s Super League club have signed a record breaking front of shirt sponsorship deal with the American sportswear company
content: The Women’s Super League club London City Lionesses’ new front-of-shirt sponsorship deal with Nike is the largest in the women’s game, according to their American owner, Michele Kang. The length and value of the deal has not been disclosed but sources close to the WSL club are hailing it as a gamechanging moment and Kang claims that it even exceeds some men’s Premier League clubs’ shirt deals. London City, who host Manchester United on Friday in the opening game of the new WSL campaign, are about to embark on only their second top-flight season, but this summer they have shocked the sport by signing a flurry of some of the biggest names in women’s football, including the former Ballon d’Or winner Alexia Putellas, the former England goalkeeper Mary Earps and Putellas’ Spain and Barcelona teammate, Mapi León. It has been reported that the largest current front-of-shirt sponsorship deal for a women’s football team is an approximately $4m per year agreement reached by the new NWSL franchise in Atlanta – who will begin competing in 2028, but Kang told BBC Sport: “I can absolutely confirm that this is the largest women-only front-of-shirt deal. It is higher than the Atlanta number. “I can absolutely also share that it is higher than some of the men’s Premier League front-of-shirt deals. It’s huge. That’s why it is landmark. There are so many other people who believe in the future of women’s football. They [Nike] didn’t make this decision lightly. They did not write a charity cheque. They believe in the future and they believe together we will invest and build this future together.” The deal will be a major boost to London City’s finances. In their most recent set of financial accounts, they posted an annual revenue of just £902,000 for the 2024-25 season, when they won promotion to the top flight. Their operating loss was over £10m, and more than 10 times that revenue. Their transfer business has attracted questions about how they can fit their lavish spending within the salary cap, as the WSL’s rules dictate that clubs cannot spend more on their player wage bills than 80% of their relevant revenue plus up to £4m of owner contributions. But it is understood this Nike deal will transform their annual revenue astronomically compared to previous seasons. The popularity on social media of their biggest new signing Alexia Putellas – who has 3.4 million Instagram followers – and Earps and León is believed to have been a major driving factor in the supposedly high valuation from Nike. Putellas has helped Spain win 2023’s World Cup and won the Champions League four times with Barcelona. The Spaniard shared the news of the sponsorship on her Instagram account on Thursday.
chineseTitle: “意义重大”：耐克的交易为伦敦城市母狮队在 WSL 中开辟了新天地
chineseSummary: 女子超级联赛俱乐部与美国运动服装公司签署了创纪录的球衣赞助协议
chineseContent: 据女足超级联赛俱乐部伦敦城狮队的美国老板米歇尔·康 (Michele Kang) 介绍，该队与 Nike 达成的新球衣胸前赞助协议是女子足球界规模最大的。这笔交易的长度和价值尚未披露，但与 WSL 俱乐部关系密切的消息人士称赞这是一个改变游戏规则的时刻，康声称它甚至超过了一些英超男子俱乐部的球衣交易。伦敦城队将于周五在新赛季女足超级联赛的首场比赛中主场迎战曼联队，即将开启她们的第二个顶级联赛赛季，但今年夏天，她们签下了一系列女足大牌，震惊了整个足坛，其中包括前金球奖得主亚历克西娅·普特拉斯、前英格兰门将玛丽·厄普斯以及普特拉斯的西班牙和巴塞罗那队友马皮·莱昂。据报道，目前女子足球队最大的球衣正面赞助协议是亚特兰大新的 NWSL 球队达成的每年约 400 万美元的协议，该球队将于 2​​028 年开始比赛，但康告诉 BBC 体育：“我绝对可以确认，这是最大的仅限女性的球衣正面赞助协议。它高于亚特兰大的数字。“我绝对也可以分享，它高于一些英超男子联赛的球衣正面协议。这是巨大的。这就是为什么它具有里程碑意义。还有很多人相信女足的未来。他们[耐克]做出这个决定并不是轻率的。他们没有写慈善支票。他们相信未来，也相信我们将共同投资并建设这个未来。”这笔交易将极大促进伦敦金融城的财政。在他们最近的一组财务账目中，他们公布的 2024-25 赛季年收入仅为 902,000 英镑，当时他们赢得了升级
